Decisions I took while planning (1 of 2)
Chosen by me, listed for QA

Verdict: only VERDICT: clean from a house-rules reviewer in page or plan mode for the page hash counts. Stale: a step goes stale when the acceptance tree fingerprint changes, not when HEAD moves. Session: the step list is filed under the payload session_id, in any mode.
chg
Decisions I took while planning (2 of 2)
Chosen by me, listed for QA

Ledger: keyed by feature, with / turned into -. Block cap: set to 1000, not 0, because what 0 means is unverified; this changes one line of the approved design. Speed first: not a blocker, since the stage file keeps both features; this branch merges main first.
chg
Acceptance tests C1 to C3
Run in step 15, saved under docs/qa/quiet-unattended-mode/
C1 rule lines: grep finds no ask or wait line outside look-or-function and hard stops. C2 presence: each mode behaves as the table says. C3 loop on: an unattended run keeps the six checks.
chg
Acceptance tests C4 to C6
Each is a line in criteria.md with proof: run
C4 approval: self-approval is refused in auto and normal mode. C5 step list: a step cannot be marked done by hand. C6 finish line: the four steps cannot be parked, replaced or deleted.
chg
Acceptance tests C7 to C9
Each is a line in criteria.md with proof: run

C7 stop check: a stop with a step open is blocked, even with no reply text. C8 assumption: a look-or-function choice is decided and listed first on QA. C9 restart: a forced stop is resumed by session id.
chg
Acceptance tests C10 to C12
Each is a line in criteria.md with proof: run
C10 QA-only: no decision is reported before the QA page. C11 gates: a run nobody can answer is not frozen by a hold. C12 reversals: each reversed decision has its dated entry.
